text: The filter works great in my Samsung refrigerator.  Be sure to run the water for a gallon or more.  The water will come out black at first, but don't worry.  It's just the charcoal from the filter.  It works itself out quickly.  The water tastes great now.
Pulled out the old one and put the new one in and followed the directions and has been working fine I would recommend buying it and I will buy another one once it needs to be replaced
Great filter, great price

Installation was easy. No leak. Water was clear, and after dumping a few glasses to clear the air in the system, everything is working normally. No one has noticed a taste difference. Edited to add, that I am on my second filter. Lasted just as long as the regular brand.
Horrible taste and off color water...even after running 1 gallon of water through it when installed. I am returning it. If you like your water to taste like dirt by all means buy it.
Went on easily and sent righr to the house!

We have a RF28HDEDBSR and this filter fit fine.  Ran some water through it to get the bubbles and any stray charcoal out and its working as expected.  No change in flavor noticed (though our water is rather flavorless to begin with).  Will buy again when its time.

Filter was delivered as promised via Amazon Prime.  It appears identical to the Samsung filter I removed. Water taste the same.  Only  difference I see at this point is  this filter is more affordable. :-)
Filter fit good and was easy to install.
Works wonderfully.  I've purchased this three or four times and every time it works great!

Returned it immediately. Product did not fit my fridge at all. I tried to install several different ways and positions but nothing. This did cause water to leak all over the floor while I was trying to force this filter into the slot. So it didn't fit and was more work since I had to clean up the water. I ended up ordering the Samsung filter which fit like a glove without any additional effort involved or a big mess to clean up.

This is the second one of these filters I have purchased.  It seems to work just as well as the more expensive Samsung unit it replaces. No leaks, fast shipping. I will buy this again when the time comes.

Did not work for me. Put it in and no water came out. Would dribble and spit a little, then nothing. Like many of these, the opening at the top in much larger than the original Samsung filter. That stinks because it hurts to pay so much for a stupid water filter. It fit well enough but ultimately didn't do me any good.

Return was painless though.
Terrible taste. Fits correctly but has a strange salty chlorinated taste even after dumping the first 5 gal of water. Will not purchase again

I installed the filter easy enough but the Red filter (replace filter indicater) light did not turn off, so I pulled the filter to closely compare to the original Samsung filter. There are minor difference in water orifice size and design, which I suspect are causing the issue. The water taste is the same as the Samsung and flow rate is better,

My wife and I noticed white flakes floating in the water. I filled 3 pots of coffee and it all had white flakes in each one of them. The named brand did not to this. Looks like we are paying the extra money.
Fits perfect and quick ship
This is a very good filter and it is compatible with my Samsung fridge. Best part is it is half the price of the one I ordered from another vendor.
Great replacement filter for my Samsung refrigerator.
This filter fits and functions perfectly in our Samsung refrigerator.  A great way to save a few dollars compared to the "branded" filter.
great product

Have it for 2 days so far; works great ....so far so good. Definitely cheaper than buying Samsung brand; let's hope it will not disappoint.
Thank you Amazon and manufacturer.
It was broken when I received it and the top flew off and hit my window from the pressure I suppose --so I had to re-order it!!
Arrived promptly, installed easily and works as expected! They even include date stickers to help remind you when you installed the filter, or you can use them for a future change date.
This product is garbage!!! It leaked as soon as I installed it.  I tried removing it and re-installing and still leaked!

so far so good. product was easy to install and it is working well no leaks as of yet and it's been 2 days. but if it does leak or the filter light goes on in less than 6 months I will let you read about it.
Fits just like the Samsung.

Went to Lowes to get a replacement filter for my Samsung refrigerator and couldn't believe the cost...almost $100! Shopped Amazon and found one much, much cheaper and have been very pleased. This is my second purchase, and I have no complaints at all.

filter arrived quickly, was easy  to install and seems to be working fine. It was very helpful that the vendor included helpful answers to typical questions. I am pleased so far and would definitely recommend them to anyone in need of this size water filter. I will surely be a repeat customer.
Easy to instsll and no leaks so far. Water tastes great just like the name brand product.

Fit perfectly into my fridge. Make sure to run about a bunch of water through your dispenser after replacing you will have air pockets and it starts off tasting chemically if you don't. But that was the same thing I had to do with the OEM part that came the refrigerator.
Web have purchased several of these and have been very pleased.
So far, so good!  Just installed it yesterday, so we'll see!

While I hope the filter works well in the long run, installation was easy (watched Abt video) and there was no leakage. Ran a couple of gallons of water and taste and color was fine. Well worth the savings over Samsung brand.
Works great less than half the price of big box stores.  I'm just wondering if it will last as along as the more expensive models.

This time I received with double plastic ring (black) on the neck and I am not able to insert into the refrigerator.
I never had this problem before...See picture. On right side of the pcitures is the orginal and a left side is the new ordered with the two plastic rings which cause the problem.
Shipping is extremely slow I received 13 days later after I purchased.

I have been ordering this product for a few months now. I live on an Army base - lots of garbage in the water. So, I like to make sure I am not buying the cheapest filter out there - I want high quality without paying brand name price.
While I have not done lab testing on the water, I can say that the taste is much better than anyone else's in the area. I change my filter more frequently than most because of how much stuff is in our water system, so the only thing I would like to see is a bulk option with this seller.
This filter works just as well as the Samsung do and for less than half the cost. Product arrived on time. This was our second purchase from Pure Line and I will buy from them again.

I didn't have any issues or problems like some others seem to have had. I just undone the old filter and installed the new filter and ran about a gallon or so through it to flush. You always have to flush any new filter. The water tastes great.

Your filter probably works very well on newer samsung refrigerators. It seemed fine when I installed it. But the next morning there was water all over the kitchen floor. I bought the $50 dollar samsung filter at home Depot and I noticed that they added a second O ring  at the end of the filter that was not on the original filter. I believe this was to rectify a design flaw that causes the filter to leak as the refrigerator ages.

Product installed perfectly and was even provided reminder labels to adhere to front of filter so I'd know to replace it in 6 months.  Buying from Amazon via this vendor saved me a bunch when compared to hardware store prices.  I would recommend this product to anyone owning a Samsung refrigerator and wants to save money while having the safety of a great compatible product.  Thanks again.
just like the real thing
Easy purchase. Easy install. Seems to be working great and saved me a lot of money!
This product was delivered quickly and works well for our Samsung refrigerator (at a lower cost, too!). Easy to install.
working just fine, so far. glad I didn't buy the one at Lowes, it was $50!

So far so good, I've had it in for a week, has same flow as OEM, water taste great.  Even Box stores are selling non OEM market brands hummm? The price is very fair and the company seems to care, and if it takes out the same amount of contaminates, so what else can you ask for!
This is my fourth replacement and each one worked perfectly!
Works just like the name brand recommended by the appliance store and was much less in price.  With Amazon's subscription service it will also be much more convenient than ordering every six months.
Works well.
Have had this aftermarket filter installed for a couple days now and it seems to be working great! This is a much more affordable alternative to the $50 OEM filter I purchased last time.
This filter is great. We are very happy with the quality and the ease of use.
works as expected.....will order again as needed!
Perfect fit
Works great! Just as described.
You are a great reliable company. Works perfect every time!

Good filter for half the price. I have a Samsung refrigerator and it requires a new filter every six months (didn't think about that when I bought the fridge). This Pure Line fit perfect, no leaks. It does have one less outer O-ring then the factory filter, but otherwise identicle. All I can say is follow the instructions and make sure things are clean. The filter is made in China, so that's on you on how you feel about products from there. For me it's working out great
Refrig water is clear, tastes good and there are NO leaks
Easy installation. Everything seems fine with it.
Works perfectly.

Faced with the price of this filter at the local box stores (over $50) we decided to take a chance with this filter. The installation was easy, it fit well. The only difference we had was the ice maker is in the bottom freezer and we just threw out the first batch of ice to make sure there were no impurities. We will definitely buy again.
Works great. Easy to insert. Somewhat more expensive than you might expect.

I did some checking on the reviews before I bought this water filter , and  it's seem to be  compatible filter to Samsung but it was not after five months it was leaking and we did not see it  leaking from underneath the front of the refrigerator and it ruined four to five planks of my floor.  I hope by writing this it will save someone from ruining their floors in the future. I do not recommend this product  for a Samsung refrigerator.  We found out from a Samsung rep that you must use a Samsung original  replacement water filter.
Perfect fit, great price! Quick shipping too.
These filters worked flawlessly and our fridge water comes out faster than with the original filter.  Very nice!

I’ve used other filter brands as well as genuine Samsung filters, so installation, flushing the line, etc... is in my DNA at this point. The Pureline is without a doubt the worst filter we’ve ever purchased. It’s like the knockoff handbag you can buy on the street. Sure, it looks kind of like the general article, but you get what you pay for. The filter leaked everywhere inside and outside the fridge within hours. Took a shot on the Pureline because of the price, but I might as well have set fire to the $20 on my porch. Would’ve got the same results. Going back to better products. Pureline did a good job generating bogus reviews to get me to purchase though, so they got that going for em.
Fits good and great price
Water tastes great again!
Works great simple install fits perfect
Perfect replacement cartridge very fairly priced.  Shipping fine.  Will continue to use this seller for this product.
It just stop working on me , didn't even last 3 months and I didn't use it that much either :(
just installed it; water is clear the taste is good.
Works great! Easy to replace old filter with this one. Good price.  Better tasting water.
Fit our Kitchenaid perfectly
After only a day the water flow was too restricted to get a glass of water. I bought a different brand and had a much better result.
I am very happy with this filter. Will order it again!

Bought it for the great price, compared to what I've paid before at Lowe's.  Installed hard, like every other filter I've had, but seems to work great!  Have only had it for a couple weeks, but so far, so good!
Love the price but have not put a new filter in my frig yet.  It is not due for a change for several months.
This arrived on time and was as expected. Will order again.
Installed easy and seems to be working really well.  I don't know the life of this, but am very pleased as of right now.
Works just as good as the OEM filters.
Great replacement filter for the Samsung fridge.  They fit, they work, and they're a bargain.  Will definitely order them again.

Filter was as described. It fit easily into the compartment. Initially the water coming out was gray but it cleared after several times of getting water out of it. Water now is very clear and clean. I would definitely buy again as it is less than half the price of retail at the big box stores.
Good replacement filter
Works. Water tastes good. No leaks.

Works just like the expensive one.
Wish I figured this out sooner.
So much cheaper for the same product!
Very happy with filter
The only difference I notice between this and the expensive brand is that the water pressure is faster with this one, which is ok with me. I will definitely buy again.
Drop-in replacement, seems to work well.  Good price, quick delivery.
Works great, as expected!
so far so good!
Perfect!!! And best at a fraction of the cost to buy locally
Great buy
WORKS GREAT CHEAPER THAN IN THE STORES, WHEN BUYING A MULTI PACK
I have used this product since I bought my French door refrigerator and and always been pleased with the quality of the water.

I have been very loyal to the OEM filters for my refrigerator over the years, but the cost always ate away at me. After reading the reviews for the waterdrop I was skeptical but for a fraction of a cost I had to give it a chance.  The filter had been in for several weeks and we have had no problems. The water comes out with the same pressure and tastes exactly the same. We are very happy we tried this product and plan on ordering more so we have them on hand.
This was clearly marked as the correct product and worked perfectly, also came quicker than rest of the order.
Same as the original filter, fits perfect.
Excelent!
Much cheaper option than brand name filter.... does exactly what other product does.
Inexpensive.  Good water pressure.  Water tastes great.  I will buy again.
Seems nicely made. Water tastes fine
Fits my mytag fridge and works great!
Works great
The same as the previous expensive brand name filters I have purchased.  Will buy again.
Way cheaper than the Pur that came with my Jenn-Air fridge. Works great...no leaks, no taste.
Direct replace for the original Kenmore filter at a fraction of the cost.  Water tastes great and flow rate is identical.
Works great
We haven't used them yet, but they appear to be exactly what we need.
Received fast and was perfect fit.
The first one is excellent and do expect the same for the others

This filter worked great in my Maytag model #MFD2561HES refrigerator. The water tastes fine and there is no chlorine smell. I assume it is doing its job. I installed this filter about five days ago and have had no problems. I will most likely purchase additional filters in the future.
The filter works as well as the more expensive ones that I have used.
Good price for the refills. Easy to install of course and comes well packaged.

This water filter works perfectly! Do not waste your money on the expensive one that the refrigerator manufacturer recommends, this does the job just as well for little cost. I will definitely buy this again when it is time to change my filter.

As a side note: When you do change the filter in your fridge, it will sputter and spit water for a few seconds. Do not freak out like I did!
This product fits and works perfectly as expected. Definitely a must have for keeping you drinking water tasting great.
It works great and at an awesome price!

Received it very promptly and in excellent form.
Packaging was wonderful and the product was easy to install.
Instructions were very simple.

The part installed great and after filling a few glasses ran clear. After a few weeks the water flow had decreased quite a bit. Still works ok but takes longer to fill a glass about like it did before I changed it.
This filter DOES NOT FILTER METALS.

Works just as well as other more expensive filters that have the same filtration rating. This filter is just as good as the mainstream brands except it's just half or a 1/4 of the price for the exact same filtering capabilities. Stop overpaying.

I got these as replacements for the Maytag UKF8001. This version works just as well at a fraction of the price and more convenient coming to the house. The only difference I found  was the initial water run after it was installed was charcoal black for a few seconds before running clear. No issues or taste.
Perfect replacement for the UKF8001 and it was on sale. Good product at a good price.
good price for the filter. Works good with Arizona hard water
Snapped right in. Good water flow. So far tastes fine. I only just put it in but so far, so good.
Works as advertised, at a lot lower price at are dealers store.
Great product. Great shipping.
Works great and a great price.  Don't pay more, this is the one to buy
Inserted easily and water tastes so much better!
Arrived in time. Easy to install. Appears to work well thus far.

fit perfectly and was installed in less than 5 minutes.Works Great.
Took 5 minutes because I had to remove the old filter and soak up
the small ant of water that leaked from it.
Fairly priced & so easy to install. My drinking water tastes a lot better!
Great product. Easy to install
Works just fine, cheaper than other brands
Works great and I saved a ton of money!! Will purchase from again.
Works just as good as others. Price for this filter is fantastic. I will buy again and definitely recommend to others.
Great price, but filter doesn't last very long.
Quick delivery quality product.

This was the cheapest filter that fits my fridge.
Works great - water flow up and water tastes better than with the one I replaced - no idea how long the old one had been in the fridge in my apartment when I moved in.
Great price, quick delivery, and easy to install. Thanks!
Happy so far so good! Great pressure, good taste, will order again, thank you Waterdrop!!
Its a water filter. It works (I think - I don't have a chemicals analysis lab at home). It is cheaper than the alternative.
The product is awesome..i will continue to use this filter for my refrigerator..
We ordered the filter and it arrived on time and fit our refrigerator.
Great filter for a great price
Installed easily.  Seems to be working fine, no leaks.
I always order a replacement when a new filter is installed.  Seems like it will work fine.  Good price and service.

Excellent option and fits refrigerators with Samsung "G" filter perfectly. Finally an option. Samsung and its resellers are getting greedy with the OEM filter. It used to cost around $25, which is a rip off in itself, but now everyone is charging $35 for it. Crazy! Samsung can keep their overpriced filter!!
Work great!
Fit perfectly and appears to work just fine. Great that it cost so much less than the name brand.
I always order extra. We use a few gallons of filtered water a day. We go through a few filters a year.
